title: DIR-073: Executive Command Palette & Search Pipeline UI/UX Overhaul
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. DOM NESTING & SIZING FIX: In src/components/cuba/CubaCommandPalette.jsx, eliminate the premature closing at line 577 so panelRef properly encapsulates the entire dialog content and removes the bottom clipping/overflow artifact. 2. ICON HYDRATION: In src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateShell.jsx buildCommands (and any other portal shells), ensure item.icon is preserved and passed to the command object so every navigation row renders its authentic Cuba icon. 3. CUSTOM SCROLLBAR & SLEEK STYLING: Replace unstyled OS scrollbars with a custom Cuba thin scrollbar (.cuba-custom-scrollbar or sleek webkit/firefox scrollbar utility) so bulky Windows scrollbars and arrow buttons never bleed into the modal. 4. M3 SEGMENTED MODE SWITCHER: Refactor the top Navigation vs AI Copilot tabs into a sleek Cuba executive segmented pill control with smooth transition, subtle glassmorphic backdrop, and keyboard accelerator badges. 5. GROUPED VISUAL HIERARCHY & KEYBOARD FOOTER: Organize search results into clean visual sections (Workspace, Job Intelligence, Account & Security) with subtle group headers. Add an executive bottom hint bar ([↑↓ Navigate] [↵ Select] [Tab AI Mode] [Esc Close]). 6. CANDIDATE ENTITY SEARCH ENRICHMENT: Wire candidate entities (resumes, portfolios, cover letters) into commandSearchProvider so typing document names surfaces actual records. 7. INVARIANTS: Preserve existing tests/cuba-design-system.test.mjs (zero hardcoded label literals in CubaCommandPalette.jsx), tests/copilot-command-surface.test.mjs, WCAG 2.1 AA combobox accessibility, and sub-4s build budget.

plan.summary: DIR-073 P0 recon complete, every finding cited to file:line. INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers (no detached node/vite daemon). Preserve tests/cuba-design-system.test.mjs (line 288 forbids a hardcoded label colon command literal, lines 225-226 require role=combobox and aria-activedescendant), tests/copilot-command-surface.test.mjs (line 241 requires EXACTLY 2 occurrences of id=cuba-command-list, line 301 pins the 429 AI_DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED verdict, lines 307-318 forbid raw colours on the copilot surface), dir021-command-copilot E2E (testids cuba-mode-navigation/cuba-mode-copilot with aria-selected and role=tab), dir012-admin-console E2E (li role=option innerTexts and combobox aria-controls=cuba-command-list), WCAG 2.1 AA, sub-4s build. FINDINGS: (1) DOM NESTING BUG CONFIRMED - CubaCommandPalette.jsx:439 opens the fixed wrapper, :445 opens panelRef (max-h-70vh overflow-hidden flex flex-col), and :577 has a PREMATURE closing div that closes panelRef BEFORE the copilot surface at :582-690, so copilot content renders outside the glass panel on the backdrop with no max-h, producing the bottom clipping/overflow artifact. FIX: delete the :577 closing div and add the missing wrapper-closing div before the closing CubaPortal (today :691 closes the wrapper, so after the fix :691 closes the panel and a new div closes the wrapper). (2) ICON HYDRATION - CubaCandidateShell.jsx:70-77 buildCommands omits icon even though the shell already computes icon: ICONS[item.id] || FiGrid per nav item at :189 (ICONS map :54-68), so command.icon is always undefined and the palette icon slot at :558 never renders. FIX: pass icon through in buildCommands and render it defensively (component vs element) in the palette, and add ICONS entries for the DIR-072 notifications and favorites ids. (3) SCROLLBAR - the palette scroll containers at :536 nav ul, :589 copilot ul and :663 result text use bare overflow-y-auto so bulky Windows OS scrollbars with arrow buttons bleed into the modal. FIX: reuse the existing certified .cuba-scrollbar utility (src/styles/cuba-tokens.css:701-730, already used by M3NotificationCenter.jsx:279), no new CSS. (4) SEGMENTED SWITCHER - the mode tabs at :462-497 are plain rounded-t buttons. FIX: restyle into a Cuba executive segmented pill (glass backdrop plus sliding indicator plus kbd accelerator badges) while PRESERVING role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls=cuba-command-list and data-testid=cuba-mode-navigation/cuba-mode-copilot so the dir021 E2E stays green. (5) GROUPING AND FOOTER - results at :545-573 are flat. FIX: insert group-header rows with role=presentation whenever command.group changes, keeping each option id=cuba-command-index, role=option and aria-selected, and keeping the exact count of id=cuba-command-list at 2, plus add an executive bottom hint bar with Up/Down Navigate, Enter Select, Tab AI Mode and Esc Close, with the AI hint gated on copilotEnabled. (6) ENTITY SEARCH - CubaCandidateShell renders CubaAppShell directly and never passes commandSearchProvider, so candidate entity search is absent. FIX: NEW src/components/Candidate/command/candidateEntitySearch.js mirroring adminEntitySearch.js, using the real candidate list APIs getResumes() at src/services/api/resumes.js:3, getPortfolios() at src/services/api/portfolios.js:48 and getCovers() at src/services/api/covers.js:3, filtering by the typed term and mapping each hit to id/label/group/to/icon with ZERO fabricated records, then wiring commandSearchProvider into CubaAppShell from CubaCandidateShell.jsx.
